cards.name: Thaïs, the Flatterer
cards.text: On Play: Draw a card.
cards.flavor: She praised every man who had something to give her.
cards.art: A smiling woman in a veil holding out an open hand full of gold coins.

cards.name: Ciampolo, the Barrator
cards.flavor: Boiling pitch on his skin, and still he tries to climb out.
cards.art: A naked man climbing out of a black pool of boiling pitch, reaching for the edge.

cards.name: Boiling Pitch
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to an enemy minion and Freeze it.
cards.flavor: The pitch scalds whoever tries to climb out, and holds them under.
cards.art: A bubbling cauldron of black pitch with a single hand reaching up from the surface.

cards.name: Sinon's Lie
cards.text: Gain 2 Mana this turn only.
cards.flavor: One false story, and the gates open from the inside.
cards.art: A large wooden horse standing outside a city wall at dusk.

cards.name: Jason, the Seducer
cards.text: Swift.
cards.flavor: He won the hearts of queens, then sailed away without a word.
cards.art: A bearded man in a Greek cloak stepping off a wooden ship onto a sandy beach.

cards.name: Venedico Caccianemico
cards.text: Drain.
cards.flavor: He sold his own kin for coin, and he never stopped counting.
cards.art: A man in a long cloak handing a pouch of coins to a veiled woman.

cards.name: Alessio Interminei
cards.text: Ward.
cards.flavor: All his flattery left him sitting in the muck.
cards.art: A grinning man sitting waist-deep in brown muck, holding a cup up to his mouth.

cards.name: Master Adam
cards.text: Rebirth.
cards.flavor: Swollen with water, he still asks for one more drink.
cards.art: A man with a huge round belly sitting on a stone rim, holding an empty cup.

cards.name: Gilded Lead Cloak
cards.text: Give a friendly minion +0/+3 and Ward.
cards.flavor: Shining on the outside, crushing on the inside.
cards.art: A heavy cloak of gold-coloured metal folded over a stone bench.

cards.name: Frozen Tears
cards.text: Freeze an enemy minion. Gain 2 Armor.
cards.flavor: Their tears freeze into a visor of ice.
cards.art: A single tear of clear ice hanging from the cheek of a pale face.

cards.name: Caiaphas, the Hypocrite
cards.text: Guard.
cards.flavor: Nailed to the ground, every hypocrite walks over him.
cards.art: A man stretched flat on the ground with a heavy wooden cross lying across his body.

cards.name: Pier da Medicina
cards.text: Start of Turn: Silence a random enemy minion.
cards.flavor: He sowed quarrels with his tongue, and now he cannot speak.
cards.art: A pale man with a deep wound across his throat, one hand raised as if to speak.

cards.name: Tiresias, the Seer
cards.text: Start of Turn: Draw a card.
cards.flavor: His head is turned backwards, yet he still sees what is coming.
cards.art: A man walking forward with his head twisted completely around, looking over his shoulder.

cards.name: Mosca dei Lamberti
cards.text: Last Breath: Deal 1 damage to all enemy minions.
cards.flavor: One reckless remark split a whole city in two.
cards.art: A man raising two stumps where his hands used to be, standing in a crowded street.

cards.name: Manto, the Prophetess
cards.text: Draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: She reads a city's future before the fires begin.
cards.art: A woman with long loose hair standing over a smoking bowl in an open field.

cards.name: Michael Scot, the Sorcerer
cards.text: On Play: Silence an enemy minion.
cards.flavor: He studied the stars and claimed every secret they held.
cards.art: A bearded scholar in a long robe holding an astrolabe over an open book.

cards.name: Earth Swallows the Seer
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to an enemy minion, then 1 damage to all enemy minions.
cards.flavor: The ground opened and took him, chariot and all.
cards.art: A deep crack opening in the ground beneath a horse-drawn chariot.

cards.name: The Jovial Friars
cards.text: Ward.
cards.flavor: Their gilded cloaks are made of lead, and they still smile.
cards.art: Two hooded monks in long robes walking side by side, their hoods pulled low.

cards.name: Vanni Fucci, the Thief
cards.text: Venom.
cards.flavor: He stole from the sacristy, and the serpents came to collect.
cards.art: A naked man wrapped in serpent coils, one snake sinking its fangs into his neck.

cards.name: Agnello Brunelleschi
cards.text: Last Breath: Summon a 2/2 Serpent with Venom.
cards.flavor: He trades his human shape for a serpent's, and keeps the theft.
cards.art: A man whose lower body is twisting into a serpent, coiled around a stone pillar.

cards.name: Bertran de Born
cards.text: Rebirth.
cards.flavor: He carries his own severed head like a lantern.
cards.art: A man holding his own severed head up by the hair, facing forward.

cards.name: Guido da Montefeltro
cards.text: On Play: Freeze an enemy minion.
cards.flavor: One crafty piece of advice, and he burns for it forever.
cards.art: A hooded man wrapped in a tall tongue of fire, hands clasped in prayer.

cards.name: Gianni Schicchi
cards.text: On Play: Add a copy of Gianni Schicchi to your hand.
cards.flavor: He pretended to be a dead man, and the trick paid well.
cards.art: A man in a sickroom leaning over a bed, holding a forged will and a pen.

cards.name: Myrrha's Disguise
cards.text: Give a friendly minion +2/+2 and Ward.
cards.flavor: She wore another face, and nobody questioned it.
cards.art: A veiled woman stepping out of a doorway, a cloth pulled over her face.

cards.name: Bocca degli Abati
cards.text: On Play: Freeze a random enemy minion.
cards.flavor: He betrayed his own side, and now the ice holds him still.
cards.art: A pale man with a set face, frozen in a block of ice up to his shoulders.

cards.name: Brutus, the Betrayer
cards.text: Swift.
cards.flavor: He struck his friend from behind, and the ice kept the blade.
cards.art: A man raising a dagger, frozen mid-stride inside a sheet of ice.

cards.name: Cassius, the Conspirator
cards.text: Last Breath: Freeze a random enemy minion.
cards.flavor: He led the plot, and now he is stuck in the same ice.
cards.art: A bearded man with one arm raised, sunk to the chest in a frozen lake.

cards.name: Frozen Lake
cards.text: Deal 1 damage to all enemy minions and Freeze them.
cards.flavor: Nothing moves on the lake where the traitors are held.
cards.art: A vast flat sheet of white ice with cracks spreading across its surface under a grey sky.

cards.name: Judas Iscariot
cards.text: Last Breath: Summon a 1/2 Frozen Shade.
cards.flavor: He betrayed his master, and the deepest ice keeps him.
cards.art: A man sunk in ice to the neck, head bowed low over a pale frozen lake.

cards.name: Silence of the Sowers
cards.text: Silence all enemy minions. Draw a card.
cards.flavor: Every argument ends, and every voice goes quiet.
cards.art: A crowd of people standing still with their hands over their mouths in a torchlit square.

cards.name: Archbishop Ruggieri
cards.text: Guard. Last Breath: Freeze all enemy minions.
cards.flavor: He locked his rival in a tower and let him starve.
cards.art: A bishop in ornate robes standing behind a stone tower wall, a chained figure inside.

cards.name: Fra Alberigo
cards.text: Start of Turn: Freeze a random enemy minion.
cards.flavor: He smiled at his guests, then froze them where they stood.
cards.art: A friar with ice clinging to his eyelashes, tears frozen on his cheeks.

cards.name: Wind of the Six Wings
cards.text: Deal 3 damage to all enemy minions. Freeze all enemy minions.
cards.flavor: Three faces, six wings, and the wind that freezes all of Hell.
cards.art: Six enormous dark wings beating above a frozen lake, a white wind blowing over the ice.

cards.name: Lucifer, Emperor of Hell
cards.text: Guard. On Play: Freeze all enemy minions. End of Turn: Deal 1 damage to all enemies.
cards.flavor: Frozen to the chest, he still rules the lowest pit.
cards.art: A huge winged figure with three faces, sunk to the chest in a frozen lake.

cards.name: Serpent
cards.text: Venom.
cards.art: A coiled green serpent raising its head to strike.

cards.name: Frozen Shade
cards.flavor: Locked in the ice of Cocytus up to the eyes.
cards.art: A pale ghostly figure locked inside a block of ice.
